verdict.rationale: Only indirect evidence shows control over what the cubic agent can reach. Admins opt in to linking related repositories for cross-repo reviews and to connecting Linear or Jira issues for requirement analysis. Role-based access control limits who can change team settings, and cubic.yaml centralizes review behavior. missing for 10: an explicit allowlist or permission settings for which external tools and integrations the agent may access, documented per-integration scoping or revocation controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
